questions: Should the series length be exactly the number of days in the range (i.e., (end_date - start_date).days), or should it be the number of days inclusive (i.e., (end_date - start_date).days + 1)?
Are the random selections independent, allowing duplicates in the series, or should each date be unique?
Should the time component always be exactly 00:00:00, or is any time within the day allowed (e.g., random hours/minutes/seconds)?
If start_date and end_date are the same date, what should the series length be (0 or 1)?
Should the random number generator seed affect only this function's calls, or should it globally affect other random functions in the program?
Is the distribution of dates uniform over the inclusive range (each date equally likely), or is there another distribution (e.g., uniform over days offset)?
Should the series index be a default RangeIndex, or should it have a specific index (e.g., dates as index)?
If the seed is None, should the random generator be unseeded (using system time) or should it default to 42?
